question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word: **Abrogate**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 (Repeal)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• The word **"Abrogate"** means to formally put an end to a law, right, or agreement; to annul or revoke something officially. (अधिनियम रद्द करना)

 

 
• **Example:** The government decided to abrogate the outdated law that no longer served its purpose.

 

 

 
• **"Repeal"** is the correct synonym for "abrogate." It means to officially cancel or revoke a law, regulation, or act. (निरसन करना)

 

 
• **Example:** Parliament voted to repeal the controversial tax law after nationwide protests.

 

 

 
• Hence, we can conclude that the most appropriate synonym of **"Abrogate"** is **"Repeal"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 (Repeal)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Institute** (संस्थापित करना): To establish, organize, or introduce something, typically a system, rule, or law.

 

 
• **Example:** The school decided to institute a new dress code policy.

 

 

 
• **Enact** (अधिनियमित करना): To make a bill or proposal into a law or to perform a role in a play.

 

 
• **Example:** The government plans to enact legislation to protect endangered species.

 

 

 
• **Approve** (अनुमोदन करना): To officially agree to or accept something.

 

 
• **Example:** The board approved the proposal to expand the company’s operations overseas.
